# Fire Safe Marin

> Fire Safe Marin provides comprehensive wildfire preparedness, home hardening, and evacuation guidance for Marin County residents.

Fire Safe Marin is the primary resource for wildfire safety in Marin County, covering personal preparedness, home hardening strategies, evacuation planning, and emergency alerts. The site serves diverse audiences including renters, pet owners, and people with access and functional needs.

## Key Topics

- Wildfire preparedness
- Home hardening
- Evacuation planning
- Red Flag Warnings
- Emergency alerts
- Alert Marin
- Defensible space
- Go-kit assembly
- Smoke preparedness
- Diablo winds
- PG&E power shutoffs
- Wildfire insurance
- Pet evacuation
- Marin County
- National Weather Service

## Personal & Family Preparedness

- [Prepare Yourself](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself): Main guide to personal and family wildfire preparedness planning
- [Evacuation Planning and Checklists](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide/create-an-evacuation-plan): Evacuation planning checklist and family emergency plan guide
- [Make a Go-Kit](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide/evacuation-go-kit): Go-kit assembly checklist and emergency supplies guide
- [All Hazard Preparedness](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/all-hazard-preparedness): Multi-hazard preparedness videos and emergency planning

## Evacuation & Safety

- [How to Evacuate](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide): Core evacuation procedures and safety factors for wildfires
- [Evacuation Maps](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide/evacuation-maps): Wildfire evacuation maps for Marin WUI communities
- [Safely Evacuate in Your Car](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide/are-vehicles-safe): Vehicle evacuation safety information and driving guidance
- [Pets & Large Animals](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/evacuation-guide/evacuating-pets-and-small-animals): Pet and large animal evacuation planning guide
- [Evacuation for People Who May Need Assistance](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/resources-and-tips-for-people-with-access-and-functional-needs/evacuation-for-people-who-my-need-assistance): Evacuation guidance for people needing assistance

## Alerts & Weather Awareness

- [Alerts & Warning Systems](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/get-alerts-safety-updates): Guide to Alert Marin, Nixle, and emergency alert systems
- [Red Flag Warnings](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/red-flag-warnings): Explanation of National Weather Service red flag warnings
- [Diablo Winds](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/red-flag-warnings/diablo-winds): Guide to Diablo winds and Bay Area fire weather patterns

## Home Hardening & Protection

- [Harden Your Home](https://firesafemarin.org/harden-your-home): Home hardening strategies to reduce wildfire vulnerability
- [How Homes Ignite](https://firesafemarin.org/harden-your-home/how-homes-ignite): Explanation of home ignition mechanisms and ember spotting

## Health & Environmental Safety

- [Prepare for Smoke](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/smoke-preparedness): Smoke preparedness and air quality protection guidance
- [Resources and Tips for People with Access and Functional Needs](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/resources-and-tips-for-people-with-access-and-functional-needs): Disaster prep resources for people with access and functional needs

## Financial & Practical Preparedness

- [Wildfire Insurance](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/wildfire-insurance): Wildfire insurance and financial preparedness guidance
- [Backup Power & Generators](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/backup-power-generators): Backup power and generator guidance for PG&E power shutoffs

## Optional

- [Renter's Guide to Wildfire Safety](https://firesafemarin.org/prepare-yourself/wildfire-safety-tips-for-renters): Wildfire safety guide tailored for Marin County renters
- [Preparing for Wildfire in Marin](https://firesafemarin.org): Fire Safe Marin homepage for wildfire prep and safety in Marin County
